blocks.t: tn your "Pac-Pack"" Game Conversion Kit, elght (8) IC's (which are programmed for the game "Jumpshot") are included. Six of these IC chips are eproms whose Maln Game Logic Board locations are printed on each chip's label. However, The other two IC chips (which are bi-polars) MAY or MAY NOT have P.C.B. locations printed on labels. To avoid confusing the locations of the bi-polar chips, the following list provides all of their substitute (actual) part numbers:
BP-PROM (Position "4A" on Malin Game Logic Board)
BP-PROM (Position "7F™ on Malin Game Logic Board)
Substitute Part Numbers: &18A-17AXN-BXGD. (RP=PROM: 6331-1) E18A-07AXN=BXHD (RP-PROM: 825123) E18A-O3AXN=BXPD (BP=PROM: 7603-5) E18A-77AXV-BX4D (RP=PROM: 7112E) E18A-79AAJ-BXGD (BP-PROM: 635081)
